license_declaration: Data License: public domain. Credits to words.hk appreciated.
review_policy: Normalize exactly one documented trailing variant-star marker with source_flag=variant and exact raw text preserved in normalized_variant review records. Quarantine malformed middle/multiple-star markers, non-Jyutping readings and ellipsis templates; never silently strip phonetic notation.
scope: Wordlist/pronunciations only; dictionary definitions, examples, media and other API datasets excluded.
source_updated_timezone_note: The upstream page does not state the timezone for its displayed update time.
weight_policy: No frequency supplied; imported rows have weight0 until separately attributed text frequencies are applied.
